question.text: A 3-bucket PMS portfolio (equity, debt, gold) with monthly threshold rebalancing of 5% will rebalance:

answer.text: When any bucket drifts ≥ 5% from target

explanation.text: The Logic: Any single-bucket drift triggers rebalance. Could be equity alone; others proportionally adjusted. The Trap: Simpler portfolios may need less frequent rebalancing. Cross-Exam Context: Practical. Manager's Pro-Tip: Document tolerance bands at bucket level in the IPS — unambiguous execution rule.
